raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was delivered twice, at 02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-17, so its 334 rows are duplicated. This is the only source of duplicate txn_ids: the 4,866 distinct ids fill the contiguous range 900001–904866. The duplicated rows are identical, so silver_transactions needs to keep one row per txn_id. The gold tables are rebuilt from it and need no change.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
